limitations: Static installed artifact only; no bundled code evaluated or target executed.
Module IDs recovered exactly; semantic roles are inferred and documented, not original source filenames.
Every registration and declared dependency in main.js inventoried, but AST interfaces do not constitute a complete call/data-flow graph.
REA semantic worker previously exhausted 1024/2048 MiB; this AST pass supplies bounded independent source evidence.
Exports may be assigned indirectly, through Object.assign or mutation; listed assignment interfaces are a lower bound.
Platform-specific branches coexist; Mac runtime reachability must be corroborated independently.
Parser conformance, IME/cursor timing, every undo variant, malformed Markdown edge cases and library rendering behavior remain unverified.
Original comments, TypeScript/types, build system and original project files cannot be recovered from this bundle alone.
